Sedemac Mechatronics Block Deal to See 10% Stake Sale

Sedemac Mechatronics is expected to see a block deal involving the sale of up to 44.3 lakh shares, representing 10% of its equity. Investors, including A91, Xponentia, and HDFC Life, are reportedly planning to offload this stake. The deal is valued at approximately ₹1,329 crore, with a floor price of ₹3,000 per share. The shares sold are subject to a 60-day lock-in period. The reported floor price is below the stock's closing price on Wednesday.
